mapper.sql: SELECT version_id versionId,book_code bookCode,version_no versionNo,store_id storeId,state, effective_at effectiveAt,expires_at expiresAt,content_sha256 contentSha256,created_by createdBy, approved_by approvedBy,version FROM prc_member_price_version
mapper.select: WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND version_id=#{versionId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prc_member_price_item incoming JOIN prc_member_price_item existing ON existing.tenant_id=incoming.tenant_id AND existing.level_code=incoming.level_code AND existing.sku_id=incoming.sku_id AND existing.unit_id=incoming.unit_id AND existing.version_id<>incoming.version_id JOIN prc_member_price_version v ON v.tenant_id=existing.tenant_id AND v.version_id=existing.version_id WHERE incoming.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND incoming.version_id=#{versionId} AND (v.store_id <=> #{storeId}) AND v.state IN ('SCHEDULED','ACTIVE') AND v.effective_at<COALESCE(#{to},'9999-12-31 23:59:59.999') AND COALESCE(v.expires_at,'9999-12-31 23:59:59.999')>#{from}

SELECT v.version_id versionId,i.item_id itemId,#{entitlementSnapshotId} entitlementSnapshotId, i.level_code levelCode,i.sku_id skuId,i.unit_id unitId,#{storeId} storeId,i.amount_minor amountMinor, v.currency,v.content_sha256 contentSha256, v.effective_at effectiveAt,v.expires_at expiresAt FROM prc_member_price_version v JOIN prc_member_price_item i ON i.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND i.version_id=v.version_id WHERE v.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND i.level_code=#{levelCode} AND i.sku_id=#{skuId} AND i.unit_id=#{unitId} AND (v.store_id=#{storeId} OR v.store_id IS NULL) AND v.state IN ('ACTIVE','SCHEDULED') AND v.effective_at<=#{at} AND (v.expires_at IS NULL OR v.expires_at>#{at}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN v.store_id=#{storeId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,v.version_no DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT v.version_id versionId,v.version_no versionNo,i.level_code levelCode,i.sku_id skuId, i.unit_id unitId,v.store_id scopeStoreId,i.amount_minor amountMinor, v.effective_at effectiveAt,v.expires_at expiresAt, SHA2(CONCAT(v.content_sha256,':',i.content_sha256),256) contentSha256 FROM prc_member_price_version v JOIN prc_member_price_item i ON i.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND i.version_id=v.version_id WHERE v.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND (v.store_id=#{storeId} OR v.store_id IS NULL) AND v.state IN ('SCHEDULED','ACTIVE') AND v.effective_at<#{windowEnd} AND (v.expires_at IS NULL OR v.expires_at>#{windowStart}) ORDER BY i.level_code,i.sku_id,i.unit_id, CASE WHEN v.store_id=#{storeId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,v.version_no DESC,v.version_id
